{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test pull request

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  BUILD_TYPE: Release

jobs:
  indexer-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [ "3.12" ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-n

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: indexer
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run tests
        working-directory: indexer
        run: |
          pytest tests

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      CC: clang-20
      CXX: clang++-20

    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:      
        submodules: 'recursive'
    
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '>=1.23.0'

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}

    - name: Install system libraries
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential clang-20 git cmake ninja-build zlib1g-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libsecp256k1-dev libmicrohttpd-dev libsodium-dev liblz4-dev libjemalloc-dev libhiredis-dev
#        wget https://apt.llvm.org/llvm.sh
#        chmod +x llvm.sh
#        sudo ./llvm.sh 16 all

    - name: Setup cmake
      uses: jwlawson/actions-setup-cmake@v2
      with:
        cmake-version: '3.x'

    - name: Configure CMake
      run: cmake -B ${{github.workspace}}/build -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-20 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-20

    - name: Build C++ libraries
      run: touch suppression_mappings.txt && cmake --build ${{github.workspace}}/build --config ${{env.BUILD_TYPE}} --target ton-index-postgres ton-index-postgres-migrate ton-index-clickhouse ton-trace-emulator ton-trace-task-emulator ton-index-go ton-streaming-go --parallel $(nproc)

    # - name: Test
    #   working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/build
    #   run: ./ton-index-worker/tondb-scanner/test-tondb",
  "rationale": "The build job runs actions/setup-go@v5 but does not cache the Go module cache, so Go module dependencies are re-downloaded on every run. The repository contains go.sum lockfiles in subdirectories (ton-index-go, ton-emulate-go, ton-metadata-cache), satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE precondition that cache inputs include a lockfile and the runner environment. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed by hashFiles('**/go.sum') matches the measured P-LIT-GHA-CACHE evidence (Go module caching reduced elapsed time in the experiment). All existing build and test steps, permissions, triggers, and coverage are preserved; no permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
